S/No Name of Boats Qty Remarks 1 5.4 Mtr FRP Speed Boat No.01/07 01 2 5.4 Mtr FRP Speed Boat No.03/07 01 3 5.4 Mtr FRP Speed Boat No.04/07 01 4 5.4 Mtr FRP Speed Boat No.CC/BSF/18 01 (B) GENERAL SCOPE OF REPAIR/REFIT WORK FOR REPAIRING /REFITING OF 04 NOS SIN GLE ENGINE SPEED BOATS S/No Nomenclature (a) All FRP body of speed boats i.e outer and inner including hull is required to be repaired. (b) All U-Fenders fitted all around the boat required to be replace d. (c) Under water hull surface required to be cleaned, removal of marine growth and finishing using the Gel coat/marine paint t o restore the boat appearance. (d) Whole transom of the boat required FRP repair work. (e) Reinforce the damaged hull portion by using a high quality m arine grade epoxy resin and fiber glass mat. (f) The repair area will be primed and painted to match the origi nal gel coat restoring the boat appearance. (g) The repair will be carefully shaped and sanded to ensure a s mooth seamless finish to achieve maximum speed. (h) Driver and passenger seats required to be repaired and reinstall properly. (j) The extended damaged area will be thoroughly cleaned and sanded to ensure proper bonding of FRP repair with existing b ody of boat. (k) Repairing of platform, bulk heads with marine grade ply wood . (l) Defective stiffener (longitudinal/ transverse) need to be repai red to restore the strength of hull. (m) Rowing lock and cleats foundation need to be repaired. (n) Wind screen and side glass require to be replaced. (o) Fire extinguisher ( ABC type, 01 Ltr) with holders need to be r eplaced. (p) Restore the limper hole inside the hull to connect all the buoy ancy chambers.

(q) Install the drain plug copper/brass at lowest portion of the bo at to drain the ingress water. 3. (d) Under water hull surface required to be cleaned and cleaning of marine growth and finishing using the Gel coat/m arine paint. (e) Driver and passenger seats required to be repaired and reins tall properly. (f) The damaged area will be thoroughly cleaned and sanded to ensure proper bonding with the FRP repair material. (g) A high quantity marine grade epoxy resin and fiber glass ma t will be used to reinforce the damaged area. (h) The repair area will be primed and painted to match the origi nal gel coat restoring the boat appearance. (j) The repair will be carefully shaped and sanded to ensure a s mooth seamless finish.
